name: Unified editor
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Produce ONE high-fidelity landscape desktop web app layout concept, about 1440x900, sharp readable typography. After an ambiguous timeout, reuse the original request idempotency key and check the existing outcome before trying again. Use 6-10 lines of realistic markdown so editor scale reads. Maximize editor workspace in first viewport; content should start far above y350. No overlapping toast. This is a production app mockup, not a screenshot pasted into a poster. Keep a compact labeled 176px global sidebar: Acclimate, workspace selector, Bundles, Connections, Members, Account. In main area one 44px bundle locator with channel right, 36px tabs, a single 52px workflow/status/action toolbar. Under it one unified split editor: 224px file navigation with compact search/type and Add entry, and wide editor. One 40px file toolbar with AGENTS.md, Instruction and Entry actions; editor immediately below. No large masthead, no separate back-link row, no separate workflow card. Quiet consistent hairlines. Let this feel like a thoughtful light developer IDE.
